script: Most broken players in Ultimate Team history. If you played FIFA anytime between FIFA 20 and FIFA 23, there's a good chance one little striker ruined your Weekend League. His name is Wissam Ben Yedder, and the community gave him a nickname that stuck for years. They called him the Rat King, not because of his real-life career, but because of what he did inside Ultimate Team. On paper he made no sense, because his FIFA 22 gold card was only 83-rated with 83 pace, and he stood at just 5 foot 7 while weighing around 150 pounds. But those numbers on the front of his card were basically a trap for anyone defending against him. He felt faster than his pace and more agile than his stats, because that 83 pace played like it was in the nineties thanks to his crazy agility, balance, and dribbling. He also had a 5-star weak foot, so he finished clean off either foot whether he was inside the box or outside it. Some players even said that Yedder was the most overpowered finisher, more than the 99-rated Messi he had the year before. But there's one price tag that proves exactly how far this obsession went. Back in FIFA 20, Yedder got a Team of the Season card that became worth more than 99 Messi and 99 Ronaldo. And even Yedder himself joked about it online, asking how many broken controllers this card would cause. A short, light striker most casual fans had never paid attention to ended up priced above the two greatest players alive, purely because he was simply so overpowered.
